name: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Vi
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base (config.json max_position_embeddings None). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.929 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-07-28. CAVEAT: every CER number comes from the two voices present in training; the held-out voice was never run through the ref_text path that the fine-tune was specifically built to repair, so unseen-voice cloning is untested here.
